title: 12 Best Sydney's Specialty Coffee Cafes
description: Discover Sydney's top 12 specialty coffee cafes for 2026. From minimalist pour-over bars to vibrant brunch spots, find your perfect cup in Surry Hills, Newtown, and beyond. Explore local favorites and hidden gems.

places.name: Reuben Hills
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A single origin pour-over, or their signature El Salvador filter coffee. Pair with the Baked Eggs with Chipotle.

places.name: Sample Coffee Roasters (Surry Hills)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A batch brew or a carefully crafted flat white. They often have interesting single origin espressos.

places.name: Mecca Coffee
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their seasonal espresso blend in a piccolo or a cascara tea if they have it.

places.name: Artificer Coffee
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A simple espresso or a filter coffee to truly appreciate their bean selection.

places.name: Gumption Coffee
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic flat white or a short black, expertly prepared.

places.name: Paramount Coffee Project (PCP)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try one of their rotating guest espresso blends or a unique filter coffee. The fried chicken waffles are also famous.

places.name: The Grounds of Alexandria
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their house blend espresso, perhaps with a pastry from their bakery. Explore the full brunch menu if you have time.

places.name: Moc & Mercy
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A perfectly poured latte with some of their famous house-made pastries, like the tiramisu croissant.

places.name: Dutch Smuggler
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Definitely try the K-Pop chicken toastie alongside your flat white – it’s a flavour explosion.

places.name: Coffee Alchemy
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any of their single origin espressos or a meticulously prepared pour-over to taste the bean's true character.

places.name: Brewtown Newtown
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A flat white with one of their famous cronuts – the salted caramel is a classic.

places.name: Pablo & Rusty's
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their seasonal blend in a milk-based coffee or a batch brew, paired with their avocado toast.
